boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using exotic weapons.
entries.target: 使用特殊武器时，增加 %d%% 武器伤害，增加 30 物理强度。

entries.source: , +%d%% physical damage, +%d physical save, +%d mental save
entries.target: , +%d%% 物理伤害，+%d 物理豁免，+%d 精神豁免

entries.source:
Deploy a noisy lure that attracts all creatures within radius %d to it for %d turns.
		It has %d life (based on your Cunning) and is very durable, with %d armor and %d%% resistance to non-physical damage.
		At level 5, when the lure is destroyed, it will trigger some traps in a radius of 2 around it (check individual trap descriptions to see if they are triggered).
		Use of this talent will not break stealth.
entries.target:
抛出一个诱饵来吸引 %d 码半径内的敌人，持续 %d 回合。
		诱饵有 %d 生命（基于灵巧），%d 护甲和 %d%% 非物理伤害抗性。
		在等级 5 时，当诱饵被摧毁时，它会自动触发在它周围 2 码范围内的陷阱（可鉴定某些陷阱是否能被触发）。
		此技能不会打断潜行状态。

entries.source:
Orcs?! In the west?! This is deeply alarming! We have not seen any for nearly eighty years. They must have come from the far east...
But do not let me trouble you; you brought important news and you are lucky to be alive.
entries.target:
兽人？！在西方？！这令人深感忧虑！我们已经将近八十年没见过任何兽人了。他们必定来自远东……
不过我不该用这些烦扰你；你带来了重要消息，能够死里逃生已是万幸。

entries.source:
You focus your strikes, reducing your attack speed by %d%% and increasing your Accuracy by %d and critical chance by %d%%.
		The effects will increase with your Dexterity.
entries.target:
你集中精神攻击，减少你 %d%% 攻击速度并增加你 %d 点命中和 %d%% 暴击率。
		此效果受敏捷值加成。

entries.source: Use the fear that lies at the heart of your curse to attack the minds of your enemies.
entries.target: 利用诅咒核心的恐惧，直接攻击敌人的心智。

entries.source: Thank you. Give me a few minutes. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He begins to pace back and forth absently, staring at the Orb.*#WHITE#
entries.target: 谢谢，给我几分钟。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他开始心不在焉地前后踱着步，盯着多元水晶球。*#WHITE#

entries.source: Conjure up a powerful magical wind, pushing the target back a distance of %d.
entries.target: 施放一股强力的魔法风暴，将目标击退 %d 码。

entries.source:
The first time you take damage each turn, you regenerate %d%% of the damage dealt as mana (up to a maximum of %0.2f) and %d%% as equilibrium (up to %0.2f).
		Increases Physical Power by %d, increases damage done with shields by %d%%, and allows you to dual-wield shields.
		Also, all of your melee attacks will perform a shield bash in addition to their normal effects.
entries.target:
每回合第一次承受伤害时，你将 %d%% 的伤害转化为法力 (至多 %0.2f 点)，%d%% 的伤害转化为失衡值 (至多回复 %0.2f)。
		增加物理强度 %d，增加盾牌伤害 %d%% , 并让你能够双持盾牌。
		同时，你的近战攻击附带一次盾牌攻击。

entries.source:
Increases your light and darkness resistance penetration by %d%% for %d turns, and reduces the cooldown of all Celestial skills by %d.
		The resistance penetration will increase with your Cunning.
entries.target:
增加 %d%% 光系和暗影抗性穿透，持续 %d 回合。同时，使你所有天空系技能的冷却时间减少 %d 回合。
		抗性穿透受灵巧加成。
通用 增加物理伤害

entries.source: The Spellblaze Chronicles(6): A Changed Eyal
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸纪事(6)：被改变的埃亚尔

entries.source: An Arcane Eye has seen this creature.
entries.target: 一个奥术之眼正在观察着这个生物。

entries.source: This is Kyless, your old friend. He seems dirtier than you recall and a good bit more dangerous.
entries.target: 这是克里斯，你的老朋友。他比你的记忆中更加蓬头垢面，也更加危险。

entries.source: Evolutions are special prodigies specific to a class or race. Only one evolution can be choosen, if any are available at all.
entries.target: 进阶是特殊的觉醒技，只有特定职业种族才能学习。即使有多项进阶可能，每名角色最多只能选择一项进阶。

entries.source: You cannot use Crusade without a shield!
entries.target: 使用十字军打击必须使用盾牌！

entries.source: Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle protects you from silence effects while you remain in its radius while silencing and dealing %d light damage to everyone else who enters. The circle lasts %d turns.
entries.target:
在你的脚下制造一个 %d 码半径范围的法阵，当你在法阵内，它会使你免疫沉默效果，沉默进入此范围内的敌人，并对其造成 %d 光系伤害。
		阵法持续 %d 回合。

entries.source: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
entries.target: 一个凶猛、与荒野相通的兽人。
腐化熔岩使 %s 的尸体复活！

entries.source:
Hits the target with your weapon, doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is stunned for %d turns.
		The stun chance increases with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
用你的武器攻击目标并造成 %d%% 伤害。如果此次攻击命中，则目标会震慑 %d 回合。
		震慑概率受物理强度加成。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the door and enter the underground crypt...
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#你打开了活门，小心翼翼地进入了地窖……

entries.source: Take on the aspects of aged and powerful dragons.
entries.target: 继承远古真龙的力量使你能使用强大的龙族技能。
拉希尔的旅行日记 第一部分

entries.source: Looking around... (direction keys to select interesting things, shift+direction keys to move freely)
entries.target: 正在观察四周…（按方向键定位有趣的东西，按 Shift+方向键自由移动）

entries.source: #00FF00#You gain the fungus talents school and your Mana Clash is enhanced.
entries.target: #00FF00#你获得了真菌技能树，你的奥术对撞也被强化了。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#As you don the %s, you gain understanding of the might of your race.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#当你戴上%s，你感受到了你种族的力量。

entries.source: Invoke the power of the light to heal and mend.
entries.target: 祈求光明之力来治疗并修复创伤。

entries.source: A maul-wield ogre. Ready to CRUSH!
entries.target: 一个手里拿着重锤的食人魔，随时准备将你一锤击碎！

entries.source: Completed the Master Jeweler quest with Limmir.
entries.target: 使用利米尔完成珠宝匠托付的任务“失落的知识”。

entries.source: The poison spore looks somewhat drained.
entries.target: 毒性孢子的能量似乎被抽取了。

entries.source: Myths tell of shieldsmaidens, a tribe of warrior women from the northern wastes of Maj'Eyal. Their martial prowess and beauty drew the fascination of swaths of admirers, yet all unrequited. So began the saying, that a shieldsmaiden's heart is as cold and unbreakable as her shield.
entries.target: 传说中的女武神，来自马基·埃亚尔世界的北方荒地。她的美貌和力量吸引了众多爱慕者前去，然而所有人都空手而归。因此，有这样一句谚语：女武神的心同她的盾一样冰冷而不可打破。

entries.source: Kill %d spawns of Urh'Rok on the level before killing any other elite (or higher rank) creatures, for an uncommon reward.
entries.target: 在杀死精英或更高级别的怪物之前，在楼层里杀死 %d 个乌鲁洛克的子嗣，以获取稀有奖励。
范围 %d; 持续 %d; 感知 %s
%s 的最大活动范围被设定为 %d。
